claims.title: The kernel contact sheet
notes: each tile's committed bytes are the exporter's own output, unretouched — whatever a kernel currently does to these pixels is what the page shows

finding, from proofing this spread: the engine's line breaker composes certain caption rects as a character-wrapped sliver regardless of content (frame and story verify correct in the container; the p47 probe shows the same seam) — tile 2's caption is position-nudged 2 pt to dodge it

finding, from proofing this spread: on the builds this chapter was authored against, the gaussian-blur tile's export showed a corrupted band over its right 256-px tile column (the windowed kernel's halo seam is the suspect); the tile is committed exactly as exported — check the tile, not this note
kernel roster: 128 ids across 14 families, read from plugin-image/registry/kernels.yaml

claims.title: Selections — the mask made visible
notes: selection runs at native resolution — resizeTo swaps the engine handle with no selectionBind (code reading; the resample+selection seam is untested territory this page chose not to stand on)

claims.title: Retouch — clone, heal, content-aware fill
notes: clone → Painted 15 dabs into layer “Background” — undoable (the stroke's tiles are journaled). The document and the source file
heal → Painted 11 dabs into layer “Background” — undoable (the stroke's tiles are journaled). The document and the source file
content-aware fill → Filled the selection with noise on layer “Background” — undoable. Document unchanged; Apply to recomposite.

claims.title: Paint and the raster word
notes: finding: every solid-paint stroke committed with zero dabs (brush and pencil, default and changed colour alike) while the sample-mode clone/heal on the previous page land through identical gestures — the solid-deposit lane, which brush, pencil and raster type share, is the measured suspect
brush, default colour, 150 px → Painted 0 dabs into layer “Background” — undoable (the strok
pencil, cyan, 26 px → Painted 0 dabs into layer “Background” — undoable (the strok
type → Type set in Space Grotesk.
the painted export is byte-identical to the identity baseline — no stroke or glyph landed; the captions state it
